company.name: Biodock
company.shortDescription: Biodock offers a cloud AI platform that extracts answers from image data.
company.description: Biodock's cloud platform accelerates microscopy analysis, automating months of microscopy analysis and infrastructure to minutes with our end-to-end AI architecture. Scientists enjoy auto-scaling storage, GPU compute, and 30-50% more accurate analysis.  We also have a data flywheel built into our product - we process millions of cells weekly for our free academic and enterprise customers, and we're building the largest image dataset for microscopy images, which gives us a competitive data advantage.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based AI platform for training, running, and interpreting deep learning models on biological image data without coding.
productsAndServices.name: Biodock Deep AI Platform

productsAndServices.description: A dashboard that displays analysis results with quantitative metrics, interactive object viewers, and tools for statistical comparison and data export.

insights.title: Hybrid therapeutic platform
insights.statement: Biodock combines AI-Assisted Labeling Tools with Biodock Deep AI Platform.
insights.implication: The company is positioned as a biotechnology platform with both a physical therapeutic-delivery modality and an AI-assisted discovery layer, rather than as a standalone AI software vendor.
caveats: Product descriptions are profile claims and do not establish clinical efficacy.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $8,787,213 to $13,262,547, a 1.51x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
